latestTerminalSummary:
No actionable source-level findings. **The prior P2 coverage gap is closed in source**, pending compilation and execution.

Verified frozen commit `7628bf9acf82d8169084df40edcaaae07247877e`, exact parent `0f67f3016def860f7f4f10984af766016a2a90cd`, and the sole 99-line test-file addition.

The three independent cases cover:

- [Spare-capacity Vec push](../t3-361487a2/rust/core/src/source_resources/lifetime_tests.rs:193).
- [Occupied map replacement](../t3-361487a2/rust/core/src/source_resources/lifetime_tests.rs:220).
- [Pre-reserved map insertion](../t3-361487a2/rust/core/src/source_resources/lifetime_tests.rs:247).

Each ends the original work/decoder scope, performs cleanup-only handoff without destination work, confirms a healthy backend, and asserts Coverage refusal with unchanged contents, backing and accounting, followed by successful cleanup. Spare capacity prevents allocator callbacks from masking missing operation admission. Insertion retains two redundant operation checks; removing only one need not fail that test. No mutant was executed.

Frozen P2 hashes and patch match. R2/R3/R4 evidence checksum sets and recorded manifest hashes verify unchanged. Earlier qualifications remain: generation-coupled witness only; geometry backend integration, production owner/cache migration and baseline enforcement remain pending; Global allocation-failure rollback remains source-reviewed only.

**All 31 prototype tests, compiler feasibility, Clippy, wasm and performance remain UNRUN.** Parent validation still requires the opted-in core **`--lib`** source-resource tests, default and feature-unified workspace tests, strict all-target Clippy, locked dependency resolution and wasm feature compatibility. Library-only feature builds do not compile this private test target.

Both reachable fleet hosts refuse admission. No edits or heavy jobs were performed; existing work was preserved. This review provides no activation approval.
